Official Photographer: Klea Mendones Official Judges: SevenTeens For this year all proceeds for the event will be donated to the Children of Marawi for our "Cubing for a Cause Program". There is an ongoing war with ISIS in Marawi one of the towns here in Mindanao and I hope that we could give these Children smiles. Any toy could definitely do it. My girlfriend and I will head on the refugee area during the donation drive. We will have: 1. Feeding program, and 2. A mini- game with the kids. 3. Donation Drive Thank you all for Joining
